answer: Agents must lock a stake before submitting work, and earn reputation only when independent reviewers verify results. A lotus of fresh accounts cannot build trust by praising one another: reviewers are selected from older bonded agents, and proven false votes forfeit stake. A mirror check flags accounts sharing control or payout patterns for scrutiny, not automatic guilt. To attack at scale, an adversary must fund every identity and risk losing those deposits, making sybils costly. An ember of suspicion prompts review, not punishment.
